description: Search the FDA GRAS (Generally Recognized as Safe) Notice inventory by substance, intended use or notifier. Returns GRN number, substance, intended use, basis, notifier, filing/closure dates and FDA's response letter (e.g. 'FDA has no questions'). Useful for checking whether a food ingredient has a GRAS notice before formulating for the US market. A missing notice does not mean an ingredient is not GRAS (self-affirmed GRAS exists), and a notice covers only its stated uses.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. 'allulose', 'pea protein', 'steviol glycosides'.

name: search_gras_notices
title: Search FDA GRAS notices
